task: Persist DONE milestone closeout snapshots so real DONE merge/worktree cleanup leaves milestone-closeout.json readable from the canonical main root.
outcome: After a story reaches DONE, lattice milestone_closeout --storyId=<story> from the canonical root returns a proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1 snapshot instead of Snapshot: missing.
facts: B-bfba proved the helper and transition-orchestrator can write milestone-closeout.json inside the story worktree.
After B-bfba DONE merge/worktree cleanup, canonical main did not contain .lattice/story/actives/B-bfba/milestone-closeout.json.
transition-orchestrator captures the closeout before phase metadata is persisted; done-effects later commits metadata, merges story branch to main, removes the worktree, and deletes the branch.
The durable proof must assert canonical-root milestone_closeout succeeds after cleanup, not just that the worktree-local store wrote a file.

The implementation likely belongs in DONE merge effects or the handoff between transition-orchestrator and done-effects, because that is where story-branch metadata is committed and main-root cleanup happens.
constraints: Do not fabricate closeout snapshots for stories without a milestone ledger.
Do not make milestone_status historical; it remains the live freshness view.
Keep milestone_closeout read-only and non-authoritative for production or Authority claims.
Use Lattice lifecycle commands for story metadata and avoid direct JSON metadata edits.
